Base: immediate after the Dark Trails Quest; addons: days or weeks (depends on accumulated votes)

Rathleton's magistrate rewards those who dedicate themselves to the city. After finishing the {wiki:Dark Trails Quest}, {npc:Ezebeth} gives you the **Glooth Engineer** outfit; the two addons are earned by voting on the shortcuts, dungeons and bosses of the {wiki:Rathleton Quest} with the votes obtained in the {wiki:Oramond Quest}. You also receive the achievement **Glooth Engineer**.
Rathleton's magistrate can reward people devoted to the city with an outfit and its addons.
No minimum level, but the **recommended level is 200** (because of the Dark Trails Quest).
Addon 1: base outfit, rank **Inhabitant** in the {wiki:Rathleton Quest} and at least 1 vote on **each shortcut** and **each dungeon** available.
Addon 2: base outfit, addon 1, rank **Inhabitant** and at least 1 vote on **each boss** available. You can only vote on bosses after you have already cast **150 votes** in total.
Votes for the {wiki:Rathleton Quest}, earned in the {wiki:Oramond Quest}
The dangers are those of the {wiki:Dark Trails Quest}; after that, all that is left is voting and talking to Ezebeth.
Plan your votes: you need to vote at least once on each shortcut and each dungeon (addon 1) and on each boss (addon 2), and you can only vote on bosses after 150 votes cast.
Complete the {wiki:Dark Trails Quest} (recommended level 200). You face all the creatures of that quest.
In **Rathleton** (Oramond), talk to {npc:Ezebeth}: {key:hi}, {key:outfit}. You receive the **Glooth Engineer** outfit.

To get to Rathleton: in Thais, say to {npc:Captain Bluebear} {key:hi}, {key:oramond}, {key:yes} (150 gp). You disembark at {npc:Captain Gulliver}'s raft, west of Oramond; enter the {item:Slime Slide}, go down to the ground floor, walk **east** to the small boat and use its portal; then head **north** to the main gate and **west** to the ramp up to the upper city. To go back, take the same route in reverse to {npc:Captain Gulliver} ({key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes}).
Raise your standing in the {wiki:Rathleton Quest} to the rank **Inhabitant**.
With the votes earned in the {wiki:Oramond Quest}, cast **at least one vote on each shortcut** and **at least one vote on each dungeon** available in the Rathleton Quest.
Talk to {npc:Ezebeth}: {key:hi}, {key:addon}. If you have not yet met the voting requirements, she will only explain the conditions.
While keeping the rank **Inhabitant**, cast **at least one vote on each boss** available in the {wiki:Rathleton Quest}.
You can only vote on bosses after you have already cast a total of **150 votes**.
Talk to {npc:Ezebeth}: {key:hi}, {key:addon}. You receive the second addon and the **Glooth Engineer** achievement.

If you ask about {key:addon} before meeting the voting requirements, Ezebeth explains: the first addon is for those who have voted on each shortcut and each dungeon at least once; the second is for those who have voted on each boss at least once.
